techs.name: Big Bang
techs.quote: In the beginning God created the Calabi-Yau strings, and from their vibrations came the Space and the Time.

techs.name: The Strong
techs.quote: And God divided the Strong from the gravity

techs.name: The Gravity
techs.quote: Now the space was unformed and void. The vibrations were upon the face of the manifold; and the energy of God hovered over the face of the spacetime. And God saw the spacetime, that it was good; and God created the tensor from the vibration.

techs.name: The Weak
techs.quote: And God divided the Weak from the strong

techs.name: The Higgs
techs.quote: And God said: 'Let the higgs under the least action be gathered together unto one place, and let the mass appear.' And it was so.

techs.name: The Light
techs.quote: And God said: 'Let there be light.' And there was light.

techs.name: The Electromagnetics
techs.quote: And God said: 'Let there be a electromagnetic in the midst of the light, and let it divide the electromagnetic from the weak.' And God saw every thing that He had made, and, behold, it was very good. And there was spacetime and there were fields, the 0.000000000001 second upon the big bang.

techs.name: Nuclear Fusion
techs.quote: Nuclear fusion occurs through the involvement of the weak force, producing some metals.

techs.name: Atom
techs.quote: The strong force holds the atomic nucleus together, while the electromagnetic force attracts the electrons. The hydrogen is cooked.

techs.name: CP Violation
techs.quote: 'Nothingness' means that positive and negative elements exist in equal amounts. For something to exist, this balance must be disrupted.

techs.name: Periodic Table
techs.quote: While the remnants of stars produce many elements, but they only generate elements up to iron at most. Completing the periodic table requires supernova explosions or artificial manipulation.

techs.name: Stars
techs.quote: The sun is a massive concentration of gravity that simultaneously emits a great deal of light. The Dark Ages are coming to an end.

techs.name: Molecule
techs.quote: Atoms bond together via van der Waals forces to form molecules. Once again, the electromagnetic force is at work well.

techs.name: Eyes
techs.quote: I can see that... I see.

techs.name: Notochord
techs.quote: Hmm... I get a shiver down my chord.

techs.name: Cnidaria
techs.quote: Why they came to our town? What they are came for? Even no one knows when they came, where they come from.

techs.name: Bilateria
techs.quote: My left hand? Oh it is on left side of my right hand to me. Thanks, I remember.

techs.name: Archaeplastids
techs.quote: Paramecium are algae, Daphnia are crustaceans, and amoebas are amoebas. Who cares about that?

techs.name: Memories
techs.quote: I'll die, but memories never die.

techs.name: Hearts
techs.quote: Dedicate your heart!

techs.name: Lung
techs.quote: Be careful not to smoke too much. You'll end up only being able to breathe through gills.

techs.name: Coral Reefs
techs.quote: Corals include those that branch into eight and those that branch into six.

techs.name: Vertebrate
techs.quote: Are you already unlocked spine blade swordsman?

techs.name: Vascular Plant
techs.quote: A little, frail sprout that strayed from the rivers will eventually change the entire world...

techs.name: Neocortex
techs.quote: We think with nature. We learn with parents. We play with pals. Then we rejoice.

techs.name: Hairs
techs.quote: AGE OF FUURY BEGAN

techs.name: Gland Systems
techs.quote: A meal tastes great after working up a sweat.

techs.name: Brown Algaes
techs.quote: Kelp forests supply vast amounts of nutrients to ocean. Also, it work as school for child fishes.

techs.name: Legs
techs.quote: Step on the ground, jump jump jump

techs.name: Angiosperms
techs.quote: The fragile petals open wide,Then fall upon the quiet ground.The green and growing things subside,And silence is their final sound.

techs.name: Neocerebellum
techs.quote: Let's Dance, Sing, rhythmically!

techs.name: Episodes
techs.quote: Let all the souls here rest in peace, for we shall not repeat the evil.

techs.name: Abstract Insight
techs.quote: Where are we came from. And Where I'm going to. Even, who is us. Who is whispering inside of me...?

techs.name: Sport
techs.quote: Human endurance is among the greatest in the mammals. It underpinned the prolonged physical labor of agricultural civilizations and sustained military operations. Humans also have great ability in throwing.

techs.name: Thumb Opposability
techs.quote: We able to grasp the victorious!

techs.name: Agriculture
techs.quote: 'Where tillage begins, other arts follow. The farmers therefore are the founders of human civilization.' - Daniel Webster

techs.name: Civilization
techs.quote: The agriculture leads to a population explosion. Communities rooted in indigenous beliefs eventually evolve into societies, with leaders coming to represent the land. What happens when the land runs out?

techs.name: Discovery
techs.quote: They began using mathematics to calculate the size of land. Furthermore, some curious mans are attempting to describe physical phenomena such as water pressure using maths.

techs.name: Industry
techs.quote: They have discoveried the equations of motion, designed steam or diesel engines, harnessed immense power, and lighting the world. Now, they even produce fertilizer from the air. It even seems possible to transform copper into gold. The time has come to understand the very constituents of matter.

techs.name: Atomic
techs.quote: They soared through the skies, stepping over corpses, and ultimately obtained the nuclear power capable of destroying themselves. Now, they require security to safeguard this power.

techs.name: Information
techs.quote: What began with punch cards now possesses computational and memory capabilities surpassing those of any genius on the planet. With this, calculating the trajectory of a space shuttle is a piece of cake.

techs.name: Relativistic Rocket
techs.quote: The unrealistic rockets that often appeared in physicists' hypothetical scenarios are now a reality.

techs.name: FTL Drive
techs.quote: To get from Japan to Brazil via the shortest route, you would have to pass through the center of the Earth, wouldn't you?
